**Finding: Deviation (Section 2.1)**

Section 2.1 imposes a USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment on us for three years, expressly "without reduction or termination rights" — squarely the playbook walk-away position. It also contradicts Section 7.1 (Vendor may not impose an unstated minimum-use charge) and Section 12.3 (Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment).

Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted: Section 2.1 is replaced so that there is no minimum purchase, volume, or take-or-pay commitment, volume figures are non-binding forecasts, and Fees are payable only for Services ordered or used. The comment offers the fallback (12-month commitment, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up rather than penalty) if a commitment is commercially essential.
